label: Microwave II ROM and sound banks
description: Optional. Your own Microwave II ROM gives the original waves, wave tables and the 256 factory sounds. Sound banks (.syx) appear on the SOUNDS tab.
hint: The ROM is one 256 KB image or the two 128 KB chip images (lower and upper); any file names work. A bank is named after its file.

rules.label: Sound bank (.syx)
rules.note: A Waldorf SysEx file. It shows as a bank on the SOUNDS tab if it holds Microwave II/XT sounds.
